brief_title: Effect of Rifampin on the Pharmacokinetics of Dapagliflozin in Healthy Subjects
official_title: Effect of Rifampin on the Pharmacokinetics of Dapagliflozin in Healthy Subjects

primary_outcomes.measure: AUC (area under the concentration-time curve) Single dose pharmacokinetic parameter will be derived from plasma concentration versus time data

brief_summary: The purpose of the study is to assess the effects of rifampin on the pharmacokinetics of dapagliflozin

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy subjects
* Body Mass Index (BMI) of 18 to 32 inclusive
* Women who are not of childbearing potential and men, ages 18 to 45

Exclusion Criteria:

* Evidence of organ dysfunction or any clinically significant deviation from normal in physical examination, vital signs, electrocardiogram (ECG) or clinical laboratory determinations
* Glucosuria
* Abnormal liver function tests
